# apt

Signed apt repository for [devkit](https://github.com/ericXin95616/devkit) packages, served by GitHub Pages.

**Generated by devkit's CI on every `v*` tag. Do not edit `pool/` or the index files by hand.**

## Use

```sh
curl -fsSL https://ericxin95616.github.io/apt/install.sh | sh
sudo apt install devkit-nvim-config devkit-wezterm-config docker-cache-prune
```

Or by hand:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://ericxin95616.github.io/apt/devkit.gpg | sudo tee /usr/share/keyrings/devkit.gpg >/dev/null
echo "deb [signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/devkit.gpg] https://ericxin95616.github.io/apt ./" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/devkit.list
sudo apt update
```
